The n has the same typewriter form as its neighbors; the earlier hand classification is unsupported by the scan.
The completion mark is a raised, postfixed handwritten caret. Replace the empty accent command with an explicit caret glyph.
The note is enclosed by a rounded pencil circle, not a rectangular box.
The curved pen stroke is the placement bracket for members, not an additional opening parenthesis; the parenthesis before both is already typed on the preceding line.
The physical line break divides one word, quasi-coherent; prevent an artificial interword space in the compiled text.
